The API died at 03:14:06 because the disk holding `/var/lib/stockroom` filled up, and it never came back in this log (which ends 05:29:57).

Starting at 03:05:00 the `report-export` job wrote a 512 MB CSV into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` every 12 seconds: 40 files, about 20 GB, by 03:12:48. The disk warned at 91% (03:09:03) and 99% (03:13:30). At 03:14:00 Postgres failed with "could not extend file … No space left on device"; the API aborted its transaction, shut down its worker pool and exited with status 1 at 03:14:06. From 03:16:00 the proxy logged "upstream api refused connection" every two minutes, 67 times, through 05:28:00, while web and proxy kept serving 200s.

The log shows no API restart, despite `restart: unless-stopped` in the compose file.

The cache "slow command" warnings are unrelated: they run every ~5 minutes from 02:00, before and after the crash.

To recover, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, then start the API. To stop a repeat, the export needs to write to a different volume from the database, or be capped. I couldn't find the `report-export` job anywhere in `app/` or `scripts/`, so it is defined outside this repo.

Every entry in this log is dated 2026-03-09, not last night. If the API went down again yesterday, this file doesn't cover it and I'd need the current log.
